Technical Procedure
Procedure:
 Equipment Inspection ( I1- 
 Depending on External 
 Leakage)
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment 
inspection checklist I1 (to check leakage from pipes of boiler equipment)
The first draft 
initiated and tested by eng. Fawzy Ahmed Bassiouny, accepted by general manager eng. 
Saad Mostafa, revised by eng.
Samir Abed El 
Gelil at EDEPC, and approved by eng. Awad Mohammed Fathy Soliman Head Sector 
of Talkha power station.
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area,
Wear safety 
 helmet, shoes.
A work permit 
 must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category.
Boiler out of service and pressure should be 
 zero.
Vents opened
Tools and Equipment
Cleaning fluid.
Complete maintenance tool set,
Suitable lifting device
Grinder & grinding wheel.
Selected filler metal for TIG 
 welding (Argon) and suitable weld wire table 1
Welding machine.
Work to be Carried Out
Before Boiler Shutdown
Check quantity of feeding water on chart at control room.
Check any leakage from pipes
 of ceiling super heaters 1, 2, 3, 4, and re heaters 1, 2, evaporator 
 'walls" and economizer.
Check drum water level on chart 
 at control room.
Check quantity of feeding water on chart at control room.
Check any leakage from pipes
 of ceiling super heaters 1, 2, 3, 4, and re heaters 1, 2, evaporator 
 'walls" and economizer.
Check drum water level on chart 
 at control room.
After Boiler Shutdown
Be sure the feed water pump out of operation,
Check the pressure inside boiler equal zero 
 and pressure inside all walls zero.
Be sure walls drum, Super heaters, and Re-heaters drained.
Vents opened.
Inspection of the Defected Pipes
Clean every part well 
 before any inspection.
Operate the feed pump to increase pressure 
 boiler from 0 to10MPa (hydraulic pressure test to detect any water leaks )
Remove the steel sheet cover and thermal 
 insulation of the chamber at the respective damage pipe.
Check all pipes to find damage and remark on 
 it.
Repair the Defected Pipes
After finding out of the place of failure 
 pipes.
Remove the fixing parts as the suspensions, 
 and bonds
Cut out the damaged pipes.
If you find any cracks you can weld re. 
 table1
Grind the edges to be ready for welding.
New pipes should be prepared to be replaced
It should be fitted and welded re. table1
The length of replaced pipe must not less than 
 250 mm in the straight part of the part
The weld must be chosen in the way ensuring 
 the distance from the part welded to the pipe min. 20 mm, the distance from 
 the suspension 50 mm and the distance from the end of bend 100 mm.
After successfully welding carryout the 
 hydraulic pressure test again.
Note: If you need any help please go to the 
operating instruction for repairs and maintenance D-3.
